title: workspace error
description: Stdout of any `workspace ... --json` command that fails with a refusal (exit 1) or an invalid argument value (exit 2). The same failure is printed on stderr as `CODE: message`. Commands whose failure carries a report of its own (sync, doctor --publish-safety, migrate plan) print that report instead.

code.description: Stable upper-case code of the refusal, such as WORKSPACE_NOT_INITIALIZED.

message.description: Human-readable message, the text after `CODE: ` on stderr.
